usage: 蒜頭 (syun3 tau4) usually refers to the whole bulb of garlic.
It is commonly used to add strong flavor in many dishes.
You can buy 蒜頭 at wet markets and supermarkets.
Fresh 蒜頭 is firm and has tight, white skin.
蒜頭 is often peeled and chopped or crushed before cooking.

examples.meaning: I want to buy two bulbs of garlic.

examples.sentence: 呢啲蒜頭好新鮮，冇霉爛。
examples.jyutping: ni1 di1 syun3 tau4 hou2 san1 sin1, mou5 mui4 laan6.
examples.meaning: These garlic bulbs are fresh and not moldy or rotten.
